Your paycheck does the exact same thing it's always done, but somehow groceries cost 40% more than they did 3 years ago. Your rent went up, your car insurance went up for no real reason, and the only people who seem genuinely calm about any of this are the ones who already have money. Either way, take one income seriously as the risk that it now is, and go figure out your second one. I'll see you in the next one.
